<style>
.timeline-13-list{
    position: relative;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }
  
  /* The actual timeline-13(the vertical ruler) */
  .timeline-13-list::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: 6px;
    background-color: var(--primary);
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
  }
  
  /* timeline-13-card around content */
  .timeline-13-card {
    padding: 1rem 5rem;
    position: relative;
    background-color: inherit;
    width: 50%;
  }
  
  /* The circles on the timeline-13 */
  .timeline-13-card::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: 25px;
    height: 25px;
    right: -12px;
    background-color: white;
    border: 4px solid var(--primary);
    top: 15px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-circle);
    z-index: 1;
  }
  
  /* Place the timeline-13-card to the left */
  .timeline-13-card:nth-child(odd) {
      left: 0;
  }
  
  
  /* Place the timeline-13-card to the right */
  
  .timeline-13-card:nth-child(even) {
      left: 50%;
  }
  
  /* Add arrows to the left timeline-13__card (pointing right) */
  .timeline-13-card:nth-child(odd)::before {
    content: " ";
    height: 0;
    position: absolute;
    top: 22px;
    width: 0;
    z-index: 1;
    right: 3rem;
    border: medium solid var(--primary-ultra-light);
    border-width: 10px 0px 10px 10px;
    border-color: transparent transparent transparent var(--primary-ultra-light);
  }
  
  /* Add arrows to the right timeline-13-card (pointing left) */
  .timeline-13-card:nth-child(even)::before {
    content: " ";
    height: 0;
    position: absolute;
    top: 22px;
    width: 0;
    z-index: 1;
    left: 3rem;
    border: medium solid var(--primary-ultra-light);
    border-width: 10px 10px 10px 0;
    border-color: transparent var(--primary-ultra-light) transparent transparent;
  }
  
  /* Fix the circle for timeline-13-cards on the right side */
  .timeline-13-card:nth-child(even)::after {
    left: -12px;
  }
  
  /* The actual content */
  .timeline-13-card__content {
    padding: 20px 30px;
    background-color: var(--primary-ultra-light);
    position: relative;
    border-radius: var(--radius-m);
    gap: var(--content-gap);
   }
  
  /* Media queries - Responsive timeline-13on screens less than 600px wide */
  @media screen and (max-width: 600px) {
  /* Place the timelime to the left */
    .timeline-13-list::after {
      left: 3.1rem;
    }
  
  /* Full-width timeline-13-cards */
    .timeline-13-card {
      width: 100%;
      padding-left: 7rem;
      padding-right: 2.5rem;
    }
  
  /* Make sure that all arrows are pointing leftwards */
      .timeline-13-card:nth-child(odd)::before,
      .timeline-13-card:nth-child(even)::before {
          left: 6rem;
          border: medium solid var(--primary-ultra-light);
          border-width: 10px 10px 10px 0;
          border-color: transparent var(--primary-ultra-light) transparent transparent;
    }
  
  /* Make sure all circles are at the same spot */
      .timeline-13-card:nth-child(odd)::after,
      .timeline-13-card:nth-child(even)::after {
      left: 1.8rem;
    }
  
  /* Make all right timeline-13-cards behave like the left ones */
    .timeline-13-card:nth-child(even) {
      left: 0%;
    }
  }
</style>
